typography.instructions: Arabic text requires slightly larger baseline sizing. Use leading-relaxed for body copy. Headings must use tracking-tight to maintain modern tension. DO NOT use generic fonts. Set logical text alignment classes like text-start instead of text-left.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Use soft ambient shadows (shadow-sm) for cards, and crisp layered shadows (shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)]) for interactive elements. NO harsh shadows.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px borders with 10% opacity (border-gray-200) on all dashboard cards to define structure clearly.
visual_enhancers.radius: Subtle roundness (rounded-lg to rounded-xl). Avoid completely pill-shaped cards; keep the Swiss/B2B structural look.

component_rules.cards: Flat solid surfaces. Medical/Financial context requires clarity, so NO heavy glassmorphism on data widgets. Use pure white surfaces with subtle gray borders.
component_rules.buttons: Primary buttons: #0A2540 background, white text. Secondary buttons: Flat surface with 1px border. Hover states MUST be explicit.
component_rules.tables: Dense, crisp tabular data layouts. Use border-b on rows. Ensure horizontal scroll on mobile.
component_rules.wallets: Highlight wallet cards using the Accent Gold/Sand or deep Primary color. Include large tabular numbers for balances (Total, Pending, Available).
component_rules.forms: Use Shadcn Form inputs. Required RTL considerations: labels on the right, icons on the start (right).

layouts.app_shell: Sidebar navigation on the RIGHT (w-72), main content area on the LEFT. Header sits atop the main content area.
layouts.spacing: Generous interior padding for standard cards (p-6 to p-8), tighter spacing for dense data rows (py-3 px-4).
layouts.grid_system: Use High Density Grid (MODE B) for the dashboard overview. 1-col on mobile, 3-col or 4-col on desktop for Wallet/Status widgets.

motion.hover_states: -translate-y-0.5, shadow-md, and slight color darkening. DO NOT use generic 'transition-all'.
motion.toast: Use Sonner for notifications (e.g., successful bank transfer upload).

accessibility.data_testid: All interactive elements, buttons, and form inputs MUST have descriptive data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='upload-receipt-btn').
accessibility.contrast: Text contrast must meet APCA/WCAG standards. Do not use pure transparent backgrounds over content.

instructions_to_main_agent.RTL_CRITICAL: You must implement the app in strictly RTL layout. Set <html dir='rtl'>. In Tailwind, ALWAYS use logical properties: ms- (margin-start) instead of ml-, pe- (padding-end) instead of pr-, start-0 instead of left-0, text-start instead of text-left.
instructions_to_main_agent.fonts: Import Alexandria and Cairo from Google Fonts in index.html or global css. Apply Alexandria to headers and Cairo to body text.
instructions_to_main_agent.packages_marketplace: Design a 'Packages Market' using a grid of cards showing package image, title, price, and a 'Buy/Book' action.
instructions_to_main_agent.financial_wallets: Create three distinct wallet cards: Total Balance, Pending Balance, Available Balance.
instructions_to_main_agent.booking_lifecycle: Implement visual badges for the 3 exact statuses: Blue (قيد التسجيل), Yellow (تم إصدار التأشيرات), Green (تم التفويج).
instructions_to_main_agent.lucide_icons: When using Lucide-react arrows or directional icons, apply rtl:rotate-180 if they need to flip in RTL.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. This disrupts the human natural reading flow.
Always use modern button styles with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Ensure the code provided is JS not TSX (per system prompt).
